name: After Article 1
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on enhancing police cooperation in relation to the prevention, detection and investigation of migrant smuggling and trafficking in human beings, and on enhancing Europol’s support to preventing and combating such crimes and amending Regulation (EU) 2016/794
part_text: Article 1a In order to ensure the effectiveness of the European Centre to Combat Migrant Smuggling and to reinforce the action of the entities referred to in Article 1, points (a) to (c), the European Union shall suspend any public funding, whether direct or indirect, to associations, organisations or entities whose statutory purpose or activities consist in obstructing, contesting or legally challenging the actions undertaken pursuant to this Regulation;
